scope: NICE NG222 recommendations on severity, first-line choice, and antidepressant withdrawal.

keyRecommendations.text: PHQ-9 under 16 was defined as less severe depression and 16 or more as more severe depression.
Consider the least intrusive and least resource-intensive treatment first (guided self-help).
Paroxetine and venlafaxine are more likely to be associated with withdrawal symptoms.

clinicalBottomLine: Use the guideline severity split, start with the least intrusive appropriate treatment, and take extra care with withdrawal from paroxetine and venlafaxine.
notableCaveats: The PHQ-9 cut-point is the one this guideline used to define less versus more severe depression.

source.title: Depression in adults: treatment and management. NICE guideline NG222.
